PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.title: The Philosophers' Gaze
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.INITIAL.descript: Beyond Neow's threshold, three thinkers from different traditions wait on the road ahead. Listen to one, or decline every invitation.
See how benevolence and ritual become action.
See how impartial care and opposition to aggression measure results.
See how non-action and softness follow the situation.
Pause before deciding to proceed alone.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.KONGZI_VIEWPOINT: Benevolence explains why one restrains oneself: others matter before action begins. Ritual explains how: each act takes its proper place. The Spire has little use for ceremony, but cares greatly about play order.
Establish order with a Skill or Power before attacking.
Gain Virtue by declining an available attack.
Take no relic and keep your own answer.
Impartial care includes others in the same reckoning, and mutual benefit judges the shared result. Opposition to aggression does not mean refusing defense; it means denying aggression its result. Mozi opens the slips: check the ledger first.
Share Block and build Mutual Benefit while nobody loses HP.
Stop a declared attack and gain Block next turn.
Take no relic and keep your own answer.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.LAOZI_VIEWPOINTS: Non-action is not idleness, but freedom from contrivance. Water is soft, yet yields around force and wears down what is hard. Laozi sets down slips and jade: leave something undone, and room remains for what follows.
Play sparingly, Retain your hand, and prepare the next turn.
Leave Energy unspent and soften incoming attacks.
Take no relic and keep your own answer.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.ACT_ONE_DECLINE_: Proceeding without the philosophers is also a choice. Will you end this encounter with a bow?
Take no Act One route relic.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.KONGZI_MUDUO.des: The bell sounds before the blade is drawn. You choose ritual before force, binding yourself to order first.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.KONGZI_QING_YU_P: Cool jade rests in your hand. You choose restraint when an attack was possible, storing Virtue. At least the reward system understood.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.MOZI_MO_SE_ZHU_J: The ink-dark slips place everyone on one ledger: shared Block, and Mutual Benefit only while nobody loses HP. Shared interests are hard to tally once someone flips the table.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.MOZI_SHOU_CHENG_: The diagram is yours. Opposing aggression is not standing still to be struck, but denying the attack its result. Secure this turn first; discuss peace under heaven later.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.LAOZI_WU_WEI_SHU: The slips remain unfinished, yet their meaning continues. You refrain from excess and leave both cards and strength for the next turn.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.LAOZI_SHUI_YU.de: The jade turns with the current. You keep strength in reserve and do not contend with force; when the blow falls, half its edge is gone.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.KONGZI_DECLINE.d: You thank Kongzi but take neither bell nor jade. The question remains, and the answer is still yours.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.MOZI_DECLINE.des: You thank Mozi but take neither slips nor diagram. The consequences have been weighed; the choice remains yours.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.LAOZI_DECLINE.de: You thank Laozi but take neither slips nor jade. Non-action needs no object, and the road follows its own course.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.DECLINE.descript: You bow and accept no teaching. The road ahead remains your own answer.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.CONTINUATION.des: Your earlier choice reaches the second Act. Benevolence, ritual, impartial care, opposition to aggression, non-action, and the preservation of life each have a successor. You may also keep the old teaching and its relic.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.CONTINUATION.opt: Ask how benevolent conduct becomes a righteous choice.
Build order through learning, standards, and practice.
Turn opposition to aggression into a practiced art of defense.
Distinguish sameness and difference within the unity of all things.
Let what went unused find another use.
Preserve yourself instead of being spent by external things.
Confirm before refusing a successor; your relic will not be replaced.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.MENGZI_VIEWPOINT: Mengzi advances from benevolence to righteousness: accumulated Virtue must become action when a choice is made. Bear Paw inherits the pendant's Virtue and turns it into Energy and draw at the start of combat.
Replace Green Jade Pendant and preserve all its Virtue.
Refuse Bear Paw; the pendant and its Virtue remain unchanged.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.XUNZI_VIEWPOINTS: Xunzi entrusts order to learning, standards, and repeated practice. Skill, Attack, Skill is not sudden inspiration, but a measure that can be tested.
Replace Muduo and practice the Skill, Attack, Skill measure.
Refuse Ink Line; Muduo remains unchanged.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.QIN_GULI_VIEWPOI: Qin Guli turns opposition to aggression into the craft of defending a city. Prepare against each declared assault; if none draws blood, its edge will be dulled on the following turn.
Prepare the defense: City Defense Machinery.
Replace City Defense Diagram, prepare Block for attacking enemies, and answer a successful defense with Weak.
Refuse City Defense Machinery; the diagram remains unchanged.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.HUISHI_VIEWPOINT: Mozi enters everyone in one account, but Hui Shi moves the counters: what is alike may still differ, and what differs may still be alike. All receive the same Block; only one who finds and breaks the boundary can turn that shared measure into momentum.
Unite sameness and difference: Enumeration Counters.
Replace Ink Bamboo Slips, grant shared Block, and reward the first enemy Block you break each turn.
Refuse Enumeration Counters; Ink Bamboo Slips remain unchanged.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.ZHUANGZI_VIEWPOI: Zhuangzi looks at the great gourd and sees not uselessness, but a use not yet found. Cards left by restraint may be played more lightly tomorrow and shelter you as they are used.
Replace Wu Wei Slips and turn restrained play into Retain, reduced costs, and Block.
Refuse the Great Gourd; Wu Wei Slips remain unchanged.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.YANGZHU_VIEWPOIN: Yang Zhu values a life not burdened by external things. Energy left unused may guard your life without being lost; after the blow passes, that strength returns to you.
Replace Water Jade, preserve up to 2 unspent Energy, and regain it next turn.
Refuse Whole Life Bi; Water Jade remains unchanged.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.ACT_TWO_DECLINE_: Refusing a successor will not erase the earlier choice, and the old relic will remain. Will you bring this exchange to a close?
Replace no route relic and resolve this run's continuation.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.MENGZI_XIONG_ZHA: Bear Paw takes the pendant's place without losing a point of Virtue. It will turn that Virtue into an opening advantage; a philosophy based on direct HP loss might favor certain characters instead.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.XUNZI_SHENG_MO.d: Ink Line takes the bell's place. Order becomes a repeatable, testable measure. The Spire will inspect it every turn.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.QIN_GULI_SHOU_CH: City Defense Machinery replaces the diagram. Opposition to aggression becomes a prepared defense; if an assault gains nothing, its edge is dulled for the next turn.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.HUISHI_LI_WU_CHO: Enumeration Counters replace Ink Bamboo Slips. Block is still granted to all, but no longer erases the line between enemy and ally; you break difference from within a common measure and turn the counters into momentum.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.ZHUANGZI_DA_HU.d: The Great Gourd replaces Wu Wei Slips. Yesterday's unplayed cards were not useless; they merely awaited a lighter and safer use.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.YANGZHU_QUAN_SHE: Whole Life Bi replaces Water Jade. Reserved strength guards you without being spent; external things cannot compel you to use yourself up.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.MENGZI_DECLINE.d: You decline Bear Paw. Green Jade Pendant and its Virtue remain; your earlier benevolent conduct is not erased.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.XUNZI_DECLINE.de: You decline Ink Line. Muduo remains; the ritual order you chose earlier is not erased.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.QIN_GULI_DECLINE: You decline City Defense Machinery. City Defense Diagram remains; your earlier opposition to aggression is not erased.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.HUISHI_DECLINE.d: You decline Enumeration Counters. Ink Bamboo Slips remain; your earlier impartial care and mutual benefit are not erased.
PHILOSOPHERS_GAZE.pages.ZHUANGZI_DECLINE: You decline the Great Gourd. Wu Wei Slips remain; the room you left for later is not erased.
You decline Whole Life Bi. Water Jade remains; the way of yielding you chose earlier is not erased.

DESCARTES_METHODIC_RECONSTRUCTION.title: Rebuilding a Starting Point
Ancient skeptical texts enter a new problem through early modern rereading and dispute: Descartes does not make suspension the endpoint, but seeks a starting point for rebuilding judgments.
